PreceptDef.label: personal choice
PreceptDef.description: Leadership carries no expectation about body size.

PreceptDef.label: ample
PreceptDef.description: Leaders and moral guides should welcome larger bodies. Their expected size is about 2.07 times their fixed race baseline (145 kg for a human). New holders have five days to approach it. After that, followers receive -1 mood per undersized occupied role, at most -2. Vacancies add no body-ideal penalty. Personal preferences still determine willing extra meals.

PreceptDef.label: massive
PreceptDef.description: Leaders and moral guides should welcome larger bodies. Their expected size is about 4.36 times their fixed race baseline (305 kg for a human). New holders have five days to approach it. After that, followers receive -1 mood per undersized occupied role, at most -2. Vacancies add no body-ideal penalty. Personal preferences still determine willing extra meals.

PreceptDef.label: immobility revered
PreceptDef.description: Leaders and moral guides should welcome larger bodies. Their expected size is about 5.36 times their fixed race baseline (375 kg for a human, the ordinary unassisted mobility threshold). Mobility aids do not count against this ideal. New holders have five days of grace, then followers receive -1 mood per undersized occupied role, at most -2. Vacancies add no body-ideal penalty. Personal preference still controls willing extra meals.

PreceptDef.label: exceptional (Fantasy)
PreceptDef.description: Fantasy only: leaders and moral guides embody exceptional abundance, with an expected size of 20.5 times their fixed race baseline (1435 kg for a human). New holders have five days of grace, then followers receive -1 mood per undersized occupied role, at most -2. Vacancies add no body-ideal penalty. This ideal is dormant outside Fantasy; its saved identity is retained. Personal preference still controls willing extra meals.

li.label: body ideal unmet
li.description: One of our occupied leadership roles has not yet reached our body's ideal size.

li.label: body ideals unmet
li.description: Our leader and moral guide have not yet reached our body's ideal size.
